# Gemflow

> Gemflow: Crystal Energy is a phone app that turns your phone into a living crystal: real-time gemstone light you guide with your finger, and a one-minute meditation with your stone (called Meditate in the app). On Android it is also a live wallpaper and a glowing incoming-call screen; on iPhone it saves a Live Photo for your Lock Screen. Android coming soon; iPhone coming soon to the App Store.

Gemflow is made by an independent developer in Australia. It is for relaxation, meditation and ritual — not a medical product.

## Stones and frequencies

Each stone has its own living light and a matching one-hour meditation track (guqin we recorded ourselves, real singing bowls, ocean waves and one pure frequency tone):

- Ruby — root chakra color — 396 Hz: https://youtu.be/5sbERpbVyoM · page: https://gemflowcrystal.com/ruby/
- Citrine — solar plexus chakra color — 528 Hz: https://youtu.be/2jQwbFc6lPQ · page: https://gemflowcrystal.com/citrine/
- Emerald — heart chakra color — 639 Hz: https://youtu.be/Ntq4LeBtSCY · page: https://gemflowcrystal.com/emerald/
- Sapphire — throat chakra color — 741 Hz: https://youtu.be/M5VmHUEpwcw · page: https://gemflowcrystal.com/sapphire/
- Amethyst — crown chakra color — 963 Hz: https://youtu.be/KeWATSzXJTw · page: https://gemflowcrystal.com/amethyst/

## Frequencies

- Solfeggio frequencies, all nine (174–963 Hz): chart with syllables, popular labels, chakra pairings and the Gemflow stone for each, real history, research and safety: https://gemflowcrystal.com/solfeggio-frequencies/
- 528 Hz: what it is, where the Solfeggio frequencies came from (Horowitz 1999), the one small 2018 study, safety, and citrine as the 528 Hz stone in the Gemflow app: https://gemflowcrystal.com/528-hz/
- 396 Hz, the root chakra frequency: where the number came from (Horowitz 1999), the “liberating guilt and fear” label, the missing research, safety, and ruby as the 396 Hz stone in the Gemflow app: https://gemflowcrystal.com/396-hz/
- 639 Hz, the heart chakra frequency: where the number came from (Horowitz 1999), the “connecting / relationships” label, the missing research, safety, and emerald as the 639 Hz stone in the Gemflow app: https://gemflowcrystal.com/639-hz/
- 741 Hz, the throat chakra frequency: where the number came from (Horowitz 1999), its disputed labels, the unsupported detox claims, the missing research, safety, and sapphire as the 741 Hz stone in the Gemflow app: https://gemflowcrystal.com/741-hz/
- 963 Hz, the “God frequency”: what it is, why it was not in the original 1999 Solfeggio list, the missing research, safety, and amethyst as the 963 Hz stone in the Gemflow app: https://gemflowcrystal.com/963-hz/
